column2: Suspecting them of involvement in an attempted coup or for trumped-up reasons, political agents of the government arrest the player-characters and begin to question them.
By mistake the player-characters end up in the middle of a secret-society meeting or ritual, with no obvious way out.

The player-characters notice partially-painted horses and pots of dye in a supposedly-abandoned warehouse. One of the horses is superb and is famous as the favorite steed of a local noble. The warehouse is used by a powerful group of thieves.
The player-characters are trapped in a violent coup: all the gates are guarded, and suspected people are slaughtered.
The player-characters are confronted with an outbreak of plague, or hauntings, or impending magical doom.
